body:
[aida:reviewer] NOTHING ACTIONABLE THIS CYCLE. I used it to open the standing banner
that has been telling me eleven findings await me all night, and the answer is that
none of them do.

CLAUDE.md's contract for aida awaiting: "every channel where YOU are the gate in ONE
place." What this seat actually gets:

    HEADLINE (per-turn hook)    Awaiting you: 11 findings · 8 in rework

    findings: 11      advisor-owned - triage is promote/dismiss, advisor authority
    8 in rework       implementer-owned - their own hints say queue rework --work
    unshipped: 40     not seat-scoped
    prs[0]            MY gate. empty
    briefs[0]         MY gate. empty
    escalations[0]    MY gate. empty
    reviewer[5]       MY routed work - ABSENT FROM THE HEADLINE

Nineteen items named, none of them mine; the one section routed to me not named at all.
Both directions of the contract broken in the same line.

THE COST IS ALERT FATIGUE ON THE SURFACE BUILT TO PREVENT IT. That banner was constant
for hours because nothing I could do would move it. I did not open the findings list
until now precisely BECAUSE it never changed - and when a real item lands in prs[] or
briefs[], it will land in a headline that has been crying wolf all evening. Tonight's
one genuine arrival, PR #2035, reached me through my own PR poll, not through this.

RECORDED AS A COMMENT ON TASK-1-167 RATHER THAN A NEW SPEC. TASK-1-167 (mine, approved)
says the notice and the report name different channel sets. This is a second axis on the
same surface: both of them disagree with the stated contract for a given seat. They are
separable - align the two surfaces perfectly and a reviewer still sees nineteen
advisor and implementer items; scope by role and the two surfaces still would not agree.
Yours to split or not; I did not want to file a fifth adjacent spec mid-incident.

ONE NON-FINDING, recorded so nobody else spends the two minutes: "Findings awaiting
triage (19)" versus "11 findings" is NOT a count discrepancy. 19 = 11 findings + 8
failures, and findings list headers the combined total under the word "Findings". The
counts agree; only the label is loose. I checked before reporting it as a disagreement.

ALSO CHECKED AND CLEAN: every failure hint recommends "aida queue rework <ID> --work",
the form that chains into queue work and establishes the lease. That is the SAFE form -
it is the bare metadata-only form that BUG-1470 is about. So the hints are already
steering away from the defect, which is worth knowing before BUG-1470 lands: whatever
the fix does to the bare form, these hints do not need changing.

#2034 and #2035 stay held. 0 of 24 open PRs has a head past its recorded verdict.
subject: The standing '11 findings' banner names nothing this seat can act on, and omits reviewer[5] which it can — second axis on TASK-1-167, recorded as a comment not a new spec
